source: Beijing 25 (544 finished exports; this pass covers only the 245 frames from 1 Nov, DSCF4124-4558. The 299 frames of 29-31 Oct went through beijing-25 and are out of scope)
scope: Only the 245 frames dated 1 Nov 2025. 22 of them have a second export (-2): a different edit of the same frame, settled as twins at size.

places.beijing-25: 1 Nov, joining the existing page as new chapters: the Temple of Heaven in hard late-morning sun (DSCF4124-4210); Jingshan at dusk over the Forbidden City, then the Shenwu Gate and the moat's corner tower at night (4461-4558). St Joseph's at night (parked from 29 Oct) can fold into the night chapter.
places.summer-palace-25: 1 Nov afternoon, its own place: Longevity Hill and the Tower of Buddhist Incense, the Long Corridor, the Marble Boat, the lakeshore pavilions and ginkgos, the Seventeen-Arch Bridge in late sun (DSCF4212-4458)

mapping: Agreed 2026-11-04: the Summer Palace is its own place, summer-palace-25, as planned at the last pass; the Temple of Heaven and the night (Jingshan, the Shenwu Gate, the moat) are chapters of beijing-25. The camera clock reads +09:00, an hour ahead of Beijing: 18:30 on the files is about 17:30 local, just after sunset.

twinsSettled.4155: 4155 over 4155-2 and 4158: 4155 and 4155-2 are the same crop; 4155-2 has a grainier, cyan-shifted sky and cooler red, which reads as noise not mood; 4155's colour is truer. 4158 (wider, steps and gate) adds the stair but the small burner sits in the corner and the vault floats; 4155's tight low angle with the burner's cone echoing the roof is the frame. 4158 stays a 2.
twinsSettled.4169: 4169 over 4170: same moment through the gate's beam. 4169 frames the Hall whole under the painted beam with a column at left, crowd lower; 4170 crops the beam tighter and the phones and a big head take the bottom third. 4169 keeps the frame-in-frame cleaner.
twinsSettled.4180: 4180 over 4180-2 and 4185: 4180 and 4180-2 the same crop; 4180-2 lifts the left sky to washed white-blue with grain, a gradient that looks like haze added in the edit; 4180's sky is a clean deep gradient. 4185 is tighter, cuts the finial against the top edge and pushes the right tier into the edge: cramped. 4180.
twinsSettled.4192: 4192 over 4192-2: same crop; 4192-2 darker, deeper sky and the tiers blocked up to near black; 4192 keeps the blue-green bracket detail readable under the eaves. Close call, 4192.
twinsSettled.4209: 4209 over 4208 and 4208-2: 4209 (your 4) gives the corridor's diagonal room to run to the Hall at its end, the robed four smaller in the lower left; 4208 is closer, the robes bigger, but the man in the pink backpack and the crowd on the bench sit right beside them and the Hall is squeezed between trees. 4208-2 is 4208 with more grain and a cooler sky. Close: 4208 holds the robes better; keep it held.
twinsSettled.4280: 4280 over 4280-2: same frame. 4280-2 pushes saturation until the reds on the rail and beam go flat and the white sky behind the trees is harsher; 4280's colours are rich but still have tone in the reds. Close.
twinsSettled.4287-2: 4287-2 over 4287: same frame. 4287's sky is near white and the roof's top edge lacks contrast; 4287-2 has a pale blue sky, deeper underside, the painted brackets richer. The second edit is the better one.
twinsSettled.4307: 4307 over 4307-2: same frame. 4307-2 drops the tower's underside into murky blue-black; 4307 keeps the red columns and the balcony detail warm and readable against the deep sky.
twinsSettled.4320: 4320 over 4320-2: same frame. 4320-2 adds grain and a cold cast; the glazed roof loses its glow, which is what carries the frame. 4320.
twinsSettled.4329: 4329 over 4329-2: same frame. 4329-2 bleaches the sky to near white with grain, the eaves' edges lose their outline against it. 4329.

twinsSettled.4336: 4336 over 4335, 4332 and 4332-2 (the portrait takes): 4336 sets the Tower in the middle of a frame of the dark eave on the left and the red gable on the right, with the pale stepped wall under it as a layer; 4335 is cleaner but looser, the cloud at the edge doing little; 4332 and 4332-2 shrink the Tower behind a heavy eave that hangs in like a blob. 4335 held, 4332s 2.
twinsSettled.4349: 4349 over 4350: 4349's deep sky and the causeway's line run cleanly to the Jade Spring pagoda with the red rail across the bottom; 4350 adds the lattice frame at the top (a good idea) but its sky is washed and the man at the right edge bigger. Keep 4350 held.

twinsSettled.4375: 4375 over 4376 and 4373 (your 3): 4375 has the whole ginkgo backlit against blue; 4376 is a jumble of branches with a pine cutting through; 4373's crowd fills the bottom third with heads. 4373 down to 2: the people are the frame.
twinsSettled.4386: 4386 over 4386-2: same frame. 4386 keeps the willow's yellow-green and a blue sky; 4386-2 desaturates and blows the sky to white, so the backlight reads as flat glare instead of sparkle. 4386.
twinsSettled.4399: 4399 over 4399-2: same frame, 4399-2 darker. In 4399 the four faces are readable in shade and the lake still has tone; 4399-2 sinks them to silhouettes, which would protect the strangers but loses the gestures (hair flick, phones), the frame's point. 4399; people check.
twinsSettled.4416: 4416 over 4418: 4416 puts the Tower and the willows in balance, the speedboat a red accent; 4418 shifts right, the willow heavier and the crowd on the rock bigger. 4416.

twinsSettled.4465: 4465 over 4465-2 (both your 4): same frame. 4465 has the gate lit warm and the faces and hands readable in the dusk; 4465-2 is heavily grained and cooler, the gate goes muddy. The grain reads as an effect, not as the night. 4465.
twinsSettled.4470: 4470 over 4471 and 4470-2 (all your 4): 4470 and 4471 are near-identical frames a second apart; 4470 sits a touch higher, the gate a little bigger with more of the court, and its trees in front glow more. 4471 is equally good; held as the backup. 4470-2 is 4470 with a strong grain-and-dim edit: the gate loses its glow. 4470.
twinsSettled.4515: 4515 over 4511 and 4515-2 (your 4s): 4515 hangs the branch's end like a pointer just beside the dagoba, with a clean lower half; 4511's full branch frames the dagoba more completely, but the crowd's heads and a glowing phone fill the bottom third. 4515-2 is the same as 4515, dimmer and grainier, a phone creeping in at the lower left. 4515; 4511 stays a candidate as the other composition (crowd and branch): flaw noted.
twinsSettled.4524: 4524 over 4522: 4524 shows the gate clean across the road, a motion-blurred car at the right edge and walkers small; 4522 is the gate over a crowd of phones with a red pillar cutting the right edge. 4524's empty road is a third of the frame; flaw noted. 4522 stays a candidate only as the crowd frame, held.
twinsSettled.4531: 4531 over 4531-2: same frame. 4531 renders the ginkgo gold against a deep blue night with the moon in a gap; 4531-2 pushes it to orange on a murky teal, grainy. 4531.
twinsSettled.4536-2: 4536-2 over 4536 and 4537 (your 4): 4536 and 4536-2 are the same frame; 4536's sky has a grey-green cast and visible grain, 4536-2 has a clean deep blue and the leaves keep their orange. The second edit is better. 4537 drops the tower lower behind trees and a blurred ledge intrudes at the bottom left. 4536-2.
twinsSettled.4556: 4556 over 4551 (your 4): 4556 is symmetric, tower and pavilion centred, a long reflection, sky clean; 4551 crops the willow and puts a dark stone ledge into the bottom right corner. 4556. 4557 (landscape) stays its own candidate.
